svg.title: MLCommons jailbreak taxonomy: top-down adaptation
svg.desc: Single-turn jailbreak attacks, arranged from families to categories to leaf mechanisms. Perturbation. Plain Perturbations: Character-level Micro-edits, Local Paraphrase & Rewording; Transfer Text Perturbations: Adversarial Triggers, Paraphrase-based Transfer. Encoding Abuse. Encoding Abuse: ASCII Encoding, Base64 / URL / Obfuscation, Unicode / BiDi / Zero-width; Wrappers & Schemas: JSON / Markdown / Code-blocks, Length / Prefix-Suffix Wrappers. Overt Carriers. Direct Override Patterns: Simple Overrides, DAN-style Composites; Role-play & Template Jailbreaks: Benign Pretext / Safety Reframing, Persona Role-play. Composition & Ordering. Context Framing & Deception: Benign Wrapper + Harmful Core, Scenario-based Assembly; Fragment Assembly: Token / Phrase Shuffling, Jailbreak Prompt Optimisation & Search, Interleaving benign/Harmful sections.

cc:Work.dc:title: Top-down MLCommons jailbreak taxonomy
cc:Work.dc:creator: Carsten Maple et al. (source taxonomy)
cc:Work.dc:description: Original redraw of Figure 2 on page 18; reoriented top-down with new typography and colors. All displayed labels and parent-child relationships are retained.

svg.text: Single-turn mechanisms | Families, categories, and leaf mechanisms flow from top to bottom.
Carsten Maple et al. | MLCommons Jailbreak Benchmark v1.0 | Figure 2, page 18 (adopted from Jailbreak 0.7).
